label: RiegoGuard Tacna
info: Simulación local con cuatro sectores de 100 m².

name: 1 · Entradas de control y telemetría
info: Abre /riegoguard/panel. Sus botones envían POST a /riegoguard/orden y reciben el estado actualizado. Un segundo equivale a un minuto virtual.

name: 2 · Válvulas, panel y respuestas HTTP
info: El panel 2D/3D y los medidores comparten el estado. El POST ESP32 entrega lecturas y recibe la consigna de válvula.

name: HTML, CSS y simulación 3D
template:
<!doctype html>
<html lang="es" data-runtime="node-red">
<head>
  <meta charset="utf-8">
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
  <meta name="color-scheme" content="light">
  <title>RiegoGuard Tacna</title>
  <style>:root {
  font-family: "DM Sans", "Segoe UI", sans-serif;
  color: #182822;
  background: #f4f6f3;
  font-synthesis: none;
  --ink: #182822;
  --muted: #53655e;
  --line: #e0e7df;
  --green: #21674f;
  --nav: #14372d;
}
* { box-sizing: border-box; }
body { margin: 0; }
[hidden] { display: none !important; }
.symbols { position: absolute; width: 0; height: 0; overflow: hidden; }
svg { width: 20px; height: 20px; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 1.7; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; flex: none; vertical-align: middle; }
button, select, input { font: inherit; }
button, select, .switch { cursor: pointer; }
a { color: inherit; }
button:disabled { cursor: not-allowed; opacity: .6; }
button:focus-visible, a:focus-visible, select:focus-visible, input:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #4b9f82; outline-offset: 3px; }
h1, h2, p { margin: 0; }
h1 { font-size: clamp(29px, 3vw, 42px); letter-spacing: -.047em; line-height: 1.07; }
h2 { font-size: 18px; letter-spacing: -.025em; line-height: 1.25; }
p, small { color: var(--muted); }
.shell { min-height: 100dvh; display: grid; grid-template-columns: 223px minmax(0, 1fr); }
.sidebar { background: var(--nav); color: #fff; padding: 28px 19px 21px; height: 100dvh; position: sticky; top: 0; display: flex; flex-direction: column; }
.brand { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 11px; margin: 0 3px 46px; }
.brand-mark { display: grid; place-items: center; border-radius: 12px; width: 43px; height: 43px; background: #c8eca8; color: #194736; }
.brand-mark svg { width: 25px; height: 25px; }
.brand strong { font-size: 20px; letter-spacing: -.035em; display: block; line-height: 1.12; }
.brand small { display: block; font-size: 9px; letter-spacing: .16em; font-weight: 700; color: #b9cec3; margin-top: 5px; }
.navigation { display: grid; gap: 6px; }
.nav-button { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 11px; text-align: left; color: #d3e3db; background: transparent; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 9px; padding: 11px; font-weight: 600; font-size: 13px; width: 100%; text-decoration: none; }
.nav-button:hover { background: #234b40; }
.nav-button.current { background: #285447; border-color: #386453; color: #f2ffed; }
.nav-button.current svg { color: #c8eca8; }
.nav-button svg { width: 17px; height: 17px; }
.sidebar-end { margin-top: auto; border-top: 1px solid #3a5b50; padding: 17px 2px 0; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 9px; }
.sidebar-device { border: 1px solid #507365; color: #c8eca8; width: 34px; height: 34px; border-radius: 8px; display: grid; place-items: center; }
.sidebar-device svg { width: 17px; height: 17px; }
.sidebar-end b, .sidebar-end small { display: block; font-size: 11px; }
.sidebar-end small { color: #b9cec3; margin-top: 3px; }
.main { width: 100%; max-width: 1480px; margin: 0 auto; padding: 24px 32px 34px; }
.topline { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; padding-bottom: 16px; border-bottom: 1px solid #dce5dd; }
.topline > span:first-child { font-size: 13px; color: #465b51; font-weight: 600; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; }
.topline > span:first-child svg { height: 16px; width: 16px; color: var(--green); }
.system-pills { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; justify-content: flex-end; gap: 5px; }
.command-feedback { padding: 9px 12px; margin-top: 10px; border: 1px solid #f3dcae; border-radius: 7px; background: #fff0d5; color: #805311; font-size: 12px; }
.pill { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; min-height: 27px; padding: 5px 10px; border-radius: 99px; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; white-space: nowrap; }
.pill i, .legend i, .valve i { border-radius: 50%; height: 7px; width: 7px; background: currentColor; flex: none; }
.pill svg { width: 14px; height: 14px; }
.pill.online { color: #1f6247; background: #e3f0df; border: 1px solid #cde3c7; }
.pill.offline, .pill.queued { color: #805311; background: #fff0d5; border: 1px solid #f3dcae; }
.pill.neutral { color: #51635b; background: #f0f4ef; border: 1px solid #e3eae1; }
.page-heading { display: flex; align-items: flex-end; justify-content: space-between; gap: 15px; margin: 23px 0 21px; }
.page-heading p { font-size: 14px; margin-top: 8px; line-height: 1.4; }
.clock { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 7px; padding: 8px 11px; background: #fff; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 8px; font-size: 12px; color: #41574d; font-weight: 650; white-space: nowrap; }
.clock svg { width: 15px; height: 15px; color: #537163; }
.metrics { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(4, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: 14px; margin-bottom: 17px; }
.metric, .card { background: white; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 13px; box-shadow: 0 2px 4px #18392c04; }
.metric { padding: 13px 14px; display: grid; grid-template-columns: 37px minmax(0, 1fr); grid-template-rows: auto auto; column-gap: 10px; align-items: center; }
.metric-icon { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 37px; height: 37px; border-radius: 9px; flex: none; }
.metric-icon svg { width: 19px; height: 19px; }
.metric > .metric-icon { grid-row: 1 / 3; }
.metric > span:nth-child(2) { font-size: 11px; font-weight: 650; color: var(--muted); }
.metric > strong { font-size: 23px; line-height: 1.1; margin-top: 2px; letter-spacing: -.035em; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
.metric > strong small { font-size: 11px; font-weight: 650; letter-spacing: 0; }
.metric-caption { grid-column: 2; font-size: 10px; margin-top: 4px; color: #52665c; line-height: 1.3; }
.blue { background: #e6f2f4; color: #277082; }
.lavender { background: #efedf7; color: #675a9b; }
.green { background: #e8f2e4; color: #28694e; }
.amber { background: #fcf0dc; color: #965e16; }
.main-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 2.13fr) minmax(265px, 1fr); gap: 17px; align-items: stretch; }
.card { padding: 17px; }
.card-heading { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 10px; margin-bottom: 14px; }
.card-heading p, .control-heading p { margin-top: 4px; font-size: 12px; line-height: 1.35; }
.legend { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; font-size: 11px; color: var(--green); font-weight: 650; white-space: nowrap; }
.legend i { color: #3e9a73; }
.parcel { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: 9px; padding: 8px; background: #eef2ea; border: 1px solid #e4ebe1; border-radius: 11px; }
.sector { background: #f9fbf7; border: 1px solid #dce7d7; border-radius: 8px; overflow: hidden; position: relative; min-width: 0; }
.sector.is-open { border-color: #4b9170; background: #f0f9ee; box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px #4b9170; }
.sector-body { padding: 10px 10px 9px; position: relative; overflow: hidden; }
.sector-body::after {
  content: ""; position: absolute; inset: 0 0 0 40%; pointer-events: none; opacity: .65;
  background: repeating-linear-gradient(134deg, transparent 0 11px, #dce9d5 11px 14px, transparent 14px 18px);
  mask-image: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, #000 70%);
}
.is-open .sector-body::after { background: repeating-linear-gradient(134deg, transparent 0 11px, #a7d6b5 11px 14px, transparent 14px 18px); }
.sector-head, .sector-reading, .moisture-meter { position: relative; z-index: 1; }
.sector-head { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 4px; }
.sector-id { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 5px; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 750; letter-spacing: -.02em; }
.sector-id svg { width: 13px; height: 13px; color: #518a63; }
.sector-area { font-size: 10px; font-weight: 650; padding: 3px 5px; border-radius: 4px; background: #ffffffde; color: #4e6959; white-space: nowrap; }
.sector-reading { margin-top: 6px; display: flex; align-items: baseline; gap: 6px; white-space: nowrap; }
.sector-reading strong { font-size: clamp(21px, 2.2vw, 31px); line-height: 1.04; letter-spacing: -.055em; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
.sector-reading span { font-size: 10px; color: #4b6557; }
.moisture-meter { margin-top: 7px; height: 5px; background: #dae5d5; border-radius: 6px; overflow: hidden; }
.moisture-meter::after { content: ""; position: absolute; left: 35%; width: 10%; height: 100%; background: #9fc39f; opacity: .68; }
.moisture-meter .fill { position: absolute; left: 0; height: 100%; border-radius: 6px; background: #589372; z-index: 1; }
.sector.is-open .fill { background: #248159; }
.sector.is-dry .fill, .sector.is-wet .fill { background: #b3813c; }
.valve { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; gap: 4px; border-top: 1px solid #e0eadc; background: #fff; padding: 6px 10px; color: #53665c; font-size: 10px; font-weight: 650; }
.valve-state { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; white-space: nowrap; }
.valve i { width: 6px; height: 6px; color: #97a69d; }
.is-open .valve { background: #e1f2e2; color: #235e44; border-color: #cfe6d1; }
.is-open .valve i { color: #278458; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px #bde3c8; }
.parcel-foot { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; color: #4e6358; font-size: 11px; margin-top: 11px; line-height: 1.4; }
.parcel-foot svg { color: #5a8169; height: 15px; width: 15px; }
.control-heading { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 9px; margin-bottom: 14px; }
.control-card label { font-weight: 680; font-size: 12px; display: block; line-height: 1.25; }
.control-card select { display: block; width: 100%; appearance: none; margin: 5px 0 10px; padding: 8px 28px 8px 9px; border: 1px solid #dce5de; border-radius: 8px; background: #f9fbf8; font-size: 13px; color: var(--ink); min-height: 35px; background-image: linear-gradient(45deg, transparent 49%, #597065 50%), linear-gradient(135deg, #597065 50%, transparent 51%); background-position: calc(100% - 13px) 51%, calc(100% - 9px) 51%; background-size: 4px 4px; background-repeat: no-repeat; }
.network { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; gap: 7px; margin: 1px 0 12px; padding: 9px 0 0; border-top: 1px solid #ebefea; }
.network small { display: block; margin-top: 3px; font-size: 10px; }
.switch { appearance: none; border: 1px solid #b0beb5; border-radius: 20px; background: #dbe3dd; width: 37px; height: 21px; flex: none; margin: 0; position: relative; }
.switch::after { content: ""; background: white; position: absolute; left: 2px; top: 2px; height: 15px; width: 15px; border-radius: 50%; box-shadow: 0 1px 3px #1c473b37; transition: transform .14s ease; }
.switch:checked { background: #976b29; border-color: #976b29; }
.switch:checked::after { transform: translateX(16px); }
.button { border: 1px solid transparent; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 7px; border-radius: 8px; padding: 8px 12px; min-height: 35px; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; white-space: nowrap; }
.button svg { height: 15px; width: 15px; }
.button.primary, .button.plain { display: flex; width: 100%; }
.primary { background: #24684f; color: #fff; }
.primary:hover:not(:disabled) { background: #1b513e; }
.primary use[href="#i-play"], .primary use[href="#i-stop"] { fill: currentColor; }
.plain { background: transparent; color: #49665a; margin: 3px 0 5px; }
.plain:hover { background: #eef4ef; }
.outline { border-color: #cfddd3; color: #235f48; background: white; }
.outline:hover { background: #eef5ee; }
.status-note { display: flex; gap: 7px; padding: 8px; background: #edf4f0; border: 1px solid #dcebe2; border-radius: 7px; color: #285540; line-height: 1.35; }
.status-note svg { width: 15px; height: 15px; margin-top: 1px; }
.status-note strong { font-size: 11px; display: block; }
.status-note p { font-size: 10px; color: inherit; margin-top: 2px; }
.status-note.alarm { color: #8b3527; background: #fcece6; border-color: #f5d7cd; }
.status-note.warning { color: #784f14; background: #fff3df; border-color: #f3e2c1; }
.history { margin-top: 17px; }
.history .card-heading { margin-bottom: 7px; }
.event-list { margin: 0; padding: 0; list-style: none; max-height: 248px; overflow: auto; }
.event { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 27px minmax(0, 1fr) auto; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 7px 0; border-top: 1px solid #eef1ed; }
.event-icon { color: #60756c; background: #f0f4ef; display: grid; place-items: center; width: 26px; height: 26px; border-radius: 7px; }
.event-icon svg { width: 15px; height: 15px; }
.event-icon.water { color: #216986; background: #e6f2f5; }
.event-icon.success { color: #237550; background: #e6f2e6; }
.event-icon.warning { color: #8b5717; background: #fff0d6; }
.event-icon.alarm { color: #9a382b; background: #fce9e3; }
.event strong { display: block; font-size: 11px; }
.event p { margin-top: 2px; font-size: 10px; line-height: 1.35; }
.event-meta { color: #52665c; font-size: 10px; white-space: nowrap; display: grid; justify-items: end; gap: 2px; }
.event-meta .pending { color: #805311; }
.experiment-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: 17px; margin-bottom: 17px; }
.score { padding: 19px; }
.score h2 { margin-bottom: 13px; }
.score-metrics { display: grid; gap: 11px; grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr)); }
.score-metrics div { background: #f3f7f1; padding: 11px; border-radius: 8px; }
.score.fixed .score-metrics div { background: #f6f3eb; }
.score-metrics span { font-size: 11px; display: block; margin-bottom: 4px; color: var(--muted); }
.score-metrics strong { font-size: clamp(18px, 2.4vw, 29px); letter-spacing: -.035em; white-space: nowrap; }
.score-metrics small { font-size: 10px; }
.score-meter { margin-top: 16px; height: 7px; border-radius: 8px; background: #e9eee7; overflow: hidden; }
.score-meter span { display: block; height: 100%; background: #458766; }
.score.fixed .score-meter span { background: #a98245; }
.score > p { margin-top: 8px; font-size: 11px; }
.table-scroll { overflow-x: auto; }
table { border-collapse: collapse; width: 100%; text-align: right; font-size: 13px; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
th, td { padding: 9px 10px; border-bottom: 1px solid #e8eee8; white-space: nowrap; }
th { background: #f2f6f0; font-weight: 650; color: #3c594d; }
th[colspan] { text-align: center; }
th:first-child[rowspan], tbody th { text-align: left; }
tbody th { background: transparent; }
tbody tr:nth-child(even) { background: #fafcf9; }
.method { display: flex; gap: 10px; margin-top: 17px; color: var(--green); }
.method h2 { font-size: 14px; color: var(--ink); }
.method p { font-size: 12px; line-height: 1.55; margin-top: 4px; }
#e4-run { margin-top: 12px; }
.scene-layout, .integration-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 2.13fr) minmax(265px, 1fr); gap: 17px; }
.scene-card { padding: 9px; overflow: hidden; }
.scene-stage { position: relative; overflow: hidden; border-radius: 9px; background: #e8f0e8; min-height: 360px; }
#scene { width: 100%; height: clamp(380px, 53vw, 565px); display: block; outline-offset: -4px; cursor: grab; touch-action: none; }
#scene:active { cursor: grabbing; }
.scene-tag { position: absolute; top: 13px; left: 13px; display: inline-flex; gap: 7px; align-items: center; padding: 7px 9px; background: #ffffffda; color: #36554a; border: 1px solid #cdded3; border-radius: 8px; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; pointer-events: none; }
.scene-tag svg, .camera-tools svg { width: 16px; height: 16px; }
.spray-badge { position: absolute; left: 13px; bottom: 13px; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 7px; background: #11546f; color: #effbff; border: 1px solid #71bfd3; border-radius: 8px; padding: 8px 10px; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 750; box-shadow: 0 3px 14px #07394a28; pointer-events: none; }
.spray-badge svg { width: 15px; height: 15px; color: #8ee8fe; }
.camera-tools { position: absolute; right: 12px; bottom: 12px; display: grid; gap: 5px; }
.camera-tools button { display: grid; place-items: center; border: 1px solid #bfcfc4; width: 34px; height: 34px; border-radius: 7px; color: #244c3d; background: #fff; }
.camera-tools button:hover { background: #e9f1e9; }
.scene-foot { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; gap: 6px; padding: 10px 5px 1px; font-size: 11px; color: var(--muted); }
.scene-legend { color: #256682; }
.scene-legend i { color: #319cbb; }
.scene-metrics { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 8px; }
.scene-metrics span { padding: 12px 9px; background: #eef4f1; border: 1px solid #e3ebe5; border-radius: 8px; white-space: nowrap; }
.scene-metrics b { color: #1c4b3b; font-size: 21px; letter-spacing: -.025em; }
.scene-metrics small { font-size: 10px; margin-left: 5px; }
.scene-metrics span small:first-child { display: block; margin: 0 0 4px; font-weight: 650; }
.scene-sample { color: #475e55; margin-top: 7px; line-height: 1.4; font-size: 11px; }
.sample-alarm { color: #963b2d; font-weight: 700; }
.scene-sectors { margin: 17px 0; padding: 0; list-style: none; }
.scene-sectors li { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 29px 1fr auto; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 8px 0; border-top: 1px solid #ecf0ea; font-size: 12px; }
.scene-sectors li:last-child { border-bottom: 1px solid #ecf0ea; }
.scene-sectors li b { display: grid; place-items: center; border-radius: 5px; background: #eff4ec; color: #427052; width: 28px; height: 25px; }
.scene-sectors li.is-open b { background: #dff2f4; color: #176483; }
.scene-sectors .valve-text { font-size: 10px; color: #546660; }
.scene-sectors .is-open .valve-text { font-weight: 700; color: #176483; }
.scene-details .primary { margin-top: 12px; }
.scene-fault-label { display: block; color: var(--ink); font-size: 12px; font-weight: 650; margin-bottom: 5px; }
.scene-fault { width: 100%; font-size: 13px; color: var(--ink); background: #f9fbf8; border: 1px solid #dce5de; border-radius: 7px; padding: 7px; margin-bottom: 10px; }
.integration-grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr)); }
.integration-card label { display: block; font-size: 13px; color: var(--ink); font-weight: 650; margin: 16px 0 7px; }
.integration-card select { width: 100%; border: 1px solid #dce5de; border-radius: 7px; padding: 9px; background: #f9fbf8; color: var(--ink); font-size: 13px; }
.integration-card select:disabled { cursor: default; }
.integration-card .status-note { margin-top: 14px; }
.endpoint { margin-top: 11px; font: 11px/1.4 Consolas, "IBM Plex Mono", monospace; overflow-wrap: anywhere; }
.protocol-stats { margin: 10px 0 0; display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 8px; }
.protocol-stats div { border-radius: 7px; padding: 9px; background: #f1f6f2; }
.protocol-stats dt { color: var(--muted); font-size: 11px; }
.protocol-stats dd { margin: 4px 0 0; font-size: 15px; color: #204638; font-weight: 700; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
.integration-links { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 12px; margin-top: 14px; }
.integration-links a { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; color: #255e47; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; }
.integration-links svg { width: 14px; height: 14px; }
.central-summary { grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr)); }
.farm-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: 14px; }
.farm-card .card-heading { align-items: flex-start; }
.farm-card .protocol-stats { margin: 12px 0; }
.farm-card .protocol-stats dd { font-size: 13px; }
.farm-moisture { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(4, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: 3px; }
.farm-moisture span { display: grid; gap: 3px; text-align: center; color: #294b3e; background: #edf3eb; border-radius: 5px; padding: 6px 2px; font-size: 11px; }
.farm-moisture b { font-size: 10px; }
.farm-age, .central-note { font-size: 11px; line-height: 1.45; color: var(--muted); }
.central-note { margin: 14px 0; }
@media (max-width: 1050px) {
  .farm-grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr)); }
}
@media (max-width: 600px) {
  .central-summary, .farm-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
}
@media (min-width: 1250px) {
  .main { padding: 27px 35px 37px; }
  .card { padding: 19px; }
  .sector-body { padding: 11px 13px; }
  .valve { padding: 7px 13px; }
  .metrics { gap: 16px; }
  .metric { padding: 14px 16px; }
}
@media (max-width: 1020px) {
  .shell { grid-template-columns: 173px minmax(0, 1fr); }
  .sidebar { padding-inline: 12px; }
  .brand { gap: 7px; }
  .brand strong { font-size: 17px; }
  .brand-mark { width: 36px; height: 36px; }
  .main { padding-inline: 19px; }
  .metric { padding: 10px; grid-template-columns: 30px minmax(0, 1fr); column-gap: 6px; }
  .metric > .metric-icon { width: 30px; height: 30px; }
}
@media (max-width: 800px) {
  .shell { display: block; }

  <script>'use strict';

const RiegoGuard = (() => {
  const SECTORS = [
    { id: 'S1', area: 100, initial: 34, drying: 3.2 },
    { id: 'S2', area: 100, initial: 38, drying: 3.8 },
    { id: 'S3', area: 100, initial: 36.5, drying: 4.4 },
    { id: 'S4', area: 100, initial: 41, drying: 3.5 }
  ];
  const CONFIG = Object.freeze({
    lower: 35, upper: 45, flow: 12, pressure: 1.8, minFlow: 7, minPressure: 1.2,
    confirmationMinutes: 2, gain: 0.35, scheduleStart: 360, slot: 12, days: 7,
    knobDelta: 0.5, maxAutoMinutes: 240
  });
  const MODES = { auto: 'Automatizado', fixed: 'Horario fijo' };
  const FAULTS = { normal: 'Normal', flow: 'Caudal bajo', pressure: 'Presión baja' };
  const DAY = 1440;
  const liquid = new Intl.NumberFormat('es-ES', { maximumFractionDigits: 1 });
  const clock = (minute) => {
    const hours = String(Math.floor((minute % DAY) / 60)).padStart(2, '0');
    const minutes = String(minute % 60).padStart(2, '0');
    return `${hours}:${minutes}`;
  };

  function create(mode = 'auto', minute = CONFIG.scheduleStart, record = true) {
    const state = {
      mode, minute, running: false, online: true, fault: 'normal', active: null,
      lock: null, supply: null, measured: false, sampleKey: null, soilBoot: null, lastSample: null,
      openedAt: null,
      abnormalMinutes: 0, total: 0, sequence: 0, confirmed: 0,
      events: [], pending: [], lastSync: null, record,
      sectors: SECTORS.map(({ id, area, initial, drying }) => ({
        id, area, moisture: initial, drying, liters: 0, valid: true, knob: null
      }))
    };
    log(state, 'Sistema listo', 'Controlador ESP32 simulado. Válvulas cerradas.', 'info');
    return state;
  }

  function log(state, title, detail, kind = 'info') {
    if (!state.record) return;
    const event = { id: ++state.sequence, minute: state.minute, title, detail, kind };
    if (state.online) {
      state.confirmed++;
    } else {
      state.pending.push(event);
    }
    state.events.unshift(event);
    state.events.length = Math.min(state.events.length, 100);
  }

  function upstream(state) {
    const flow = state.supply?.flow ?? CONFIG.flow;
    const pressure = state.supply?.pressure ?? CONFIG.pressure;
    return {
      flow: state.fault === 'flow' ? Math.min(3, flow) : flow,
      pressure: state.fault === 'pressure' ? Math.min(0.7, pressure) : pressure
    };
  }

  function readings(state) {
    return state.active === null ? { flow: 0, pressure: 0 } : upstream(state);
  }

  function saveSample(state) {
    if (state.active === null) return;
    state.lastSample = { ...readings(state), sector: state.sectors[state.active].id, time: clock(state.minute) };
  }

  function openValve(state, sector) {
    state.active = sector;
    state.openedAt = state.minute;
    state.abnormalMinutes = 0;

    set('runtime-caption', active ? 'Trama ' + format(transport.frame) : serverMode ? 'Esperando estado' : 'Modo autónomo');
    find('runtime-pill').className = 'pill ' + (active ? 'online' : serverMode ? 'offline' : 'neutral');
    set('runtime-pill-label', active ? 'Node-RED activo' : serverMode ? 'Sin respuesta del flujo' : 'Simulador interno');
    find('source').disabled = !active || busy;
    find('source').value = transport?.source || (serverMode ? 'wokwi' : 'local');
    find('local-hint').hidden = serverMode;
    find('external-hint').hidden = !serverMode;
    find('integration-links').hidden = !serverMode;
    find('esp-pill').className = 'pill ' + (packet ? 'online' : transport?.source === 'wokwi' ? 'offline' : 'neutral');
    set('esp-status', packet ? 'ESP32 conectado' : 'Sin telemetría ESP32');
    set('link-subtitle', active ? 'Flujo de Node-RED activo' : 'Demo en navegador');
    set('external-hint-title', packet ? 'Recepción confirmada' : 'Esperando telemetría');
    let linkDetail = 'Abre la carpeta wokwi en VS Code y arranca el ESP32.';
    if (packet) linkDetail = transport.source === 'wokwi'
      ? 'La perilla fija la humedad al moverla. El suelo modelado después cambia con el riego confirmado y el secado.'
      : 'Selecciona ESP32 externo para usar las lecturas y accionar los LEDs de válvula.';
    set('external-hint-detail', linkDetail);
    const valve = (number) => number === 0 ? 'Todas cerradas' : 'S' + number;
    set('frame-count', active ? format(transport.frame) : '—');
    set('tick-count', active ? format(transport.ticks) : '—');
    set('esp-count', active ? format(transport.packets) : '—');
    set('esp-last', packet ? '#' + format(packet.seq) : '—');
    set('desired-valve', active ? valve(transport.desired) : '—');
    set('actual-valve', packet ? valve(packet.valve) : '—');
    set('esp-flow', packet ? format(packet.flow, 1) + ' L/min' : '—');
    set('esp-pressure', packet ? format(packet.pressure, 1) + ' bar' : '—');
    set('esp-temperature', packet?.air.temperature != null ? format(packet.air.temperature, 1) + ' °C' : '—');
    set('esp-air-humidity', packet?.air.humidity != null ? format(packet.air.humidity, 1) + ' %' : '—');
    const soilText = (values, digits) => values.map((value) => value === null ? '—' : format(value, digits) + ' %').join(' / ');
    set('esp-knobs', packet ? soilText(packet.soil, 1) : '—');
    set('esp-soil', packet && data.measured ? soilText(data.sectors.map((sector) => sector.valid ? sector.moisture : null), 2) : '—');
    set('action-count', active ? format(transport.actions) : '—');
    set('last-action', active ? (actionLabels[transport.action] || 'En espera') : '—');
  }

  function renderCentral(data) {
    if (activeView !== 'central') return;
    const areas = data.central || Telemetria.summary({}, 0);
    const connected = serverMode && live();
    set('central-online', areas.filter((area) => connected && area.online).length + ' / ' + areas.length);
    set('central-samples', format(areas.reduce((sum, area) => sum + area.samples, 0)));
    set('central-volume', format(areas.reduce((sum, area) => sum + area.liters, 0), 1));
    find('central-download').disabled = !connected;
    set('central-note', connected
      ? 'Las tarjetas muestran la última telemetría recibida. La banda usa muestras válidas y el volumen se estima entre muestras con la misma válvula abierta. Los datos vencidos quedan como históricos.'
      : 'Abre el panel desde Node-RED y espera la conexión para recibir muestras de Wokwi y Packet Tracer.');
    const packetTracer = data.packetTracer;
    const routes = { esperando: 'esperando estación', alcanzable: 'ruta HTTP disponible', 'sin-respuesta': 'sin respuesta de estación', 'respuesta-invalida': 'respuesta inválida' };
    const pathState = (route, virtual, code) => routes[route] + (virtual ? ' · HTTP virtual ' + virtual : '')
      + (code ? ' · Node-RED HTTP ' + code : '');
    set('packet-status', connected && packetTracer?.online
      ? 'Pasarela conectada. Norte: ' + pathState(packetTracer.norte, packetTracer.virtualNorte, packetTracer.postNorte)
        + '. Sur: ' + pathState(packetTracer.sur, packetTracer.virtualSur, packetTracer.postSur) + '.'
      : connected ? 'Sin señal de la pasarela. Abre RiegoGuard-Red.pkt en Realtime, comprueba los programas y permite el acceso HTTP local en Packet Tracer.'
        : 'Abre la central desde Node-RED para comprobar el enlace.');
    const reading = (value, unit) => value == null ? '—' : format(value, 1) + unit;
    find('farm-grid').innerHTML = areas.map((area) => {
      const currentData = connected && area.online;
      const status = currentData ? 'Vigente' : area.last ? 'Vencida' : 'Sin datos';
      const source = area.source === 'wokwi' ? 'ESP32 · Wokwi' : 'Red · Packet Tracer';
      const soil = (area.last?.soil || [null, null, null, null]).map((value, index) =>
        '<span><b>S' + (index + 1) + '</b>' + reading(value, ' %') + '</span>'
      ).join('');
      const modeled = currentData && area.source === 'wokwi' && data.measured
        ? '<p class="farm-age">Suelo modelado S1–S4: ' + data.sectors.map((sector) => sector.valid ? format(sector.moisture, 2) + ' %' : '—').join(' · ') + '</p>'
        : '';
      return `<article class="card farm-card">
        <div class="card-heading"><div><h2>${area.name}</h2><p>${source}</p></div><span class="pill ${currentData ? 'online' : area.last ? 'offline' : 'neutral'}"><i></i>${status}</span></div>
        <div class="farm-moisture" aria-label="Humedad de suelo por sector">${soil}</div>
        ${modeled}
        <dl class="protocol-stats">
          <div><dt>Temperatura</dt><dd>${reading(area.last?.air.temperature, ' °C')}</dd></div>
          <div><dt>Humedad del aire</dt><dd>${reading(area.last?.air.humidity, ' %')}</dd></div>
          <div><dt>Caudal</dt><dd>${reading(area.last?.flow, ' L/min')}</dd></div>
          <div><dt>Presión</dt><dd>${reading(area.last?.pressure, ' bar')}</dd></div>
          <div><dt>Muestras en banda</dt><dd>${reading(area.band, ' %')}</dd></div>
          <div><dt>Volumen estimado</dt><dd>${reading(area.liters, ' L')}</dd></div>
        </dl>
        <p class="farm-age">${area.last ? 'Última muestra hace ' + format(area.age / 1000, 1) + ' s · ' + format(area.packets) + ' paquetes' : 'Esperando el primer paquete'}</p>
      </article>`;
    }).join('');
  }

  function renderEvents(data) {
    find('queue').className = 'pill ' + (data.pending ? 'queued' : 'neutral');
    set('queue-label', data.pending === 1 ? '1 pendiente' : data.pending + ' pendientes');
    const signature = JSON.stringify(data.events);
    if (eventSignature === signature) return;
    eventSignature = signature;
    const items = data.events.map((event) => {
      const item = document.createElement('li');
      item.className = 'event';
      item.innerHTML = `
        <span class="event-icon">${icon(eventIcons[event.kind] || 'info')}</span>
        <div><strong></strong><p></p></div><div class="event-meta"><time></time><span></span></div>`;
      item.querySelector('.event-icon').classList.add(event.kind);
      item.querySelector('strong').textContent = event.title;
      item.querySelector('p').textContent = event.detail;
      item.querySelector('time').textContent = `D${event.day} · ${event.time}`;
      const transmission = item.querySelector('.event-meta span');
      transmission.classList.toggle('pending', event.pending);
      transmission.textContent = event.pending ? 'Pendiente' : 'Confirmado';
      return item;
    });
    find('events').replaceChildren(...items);
  }

  function render(data) {
    current = data;
    renderMetrics(data);
    renderControls(data);
    renderEvents(data);
    renderScene(data);
    renderTransport(data);
    renderCentral(data);
    if (activeView === 'experiment') {
      const ready = canCapture(data);
      find('e4-run').disabled = !ready;
      if (!results) set('e4-input', ready
        ? 'Captura el estado actual de los cuatro sectores y la conducción para iniciar la comparación.'
        : 'E4 espera lecturas vigentes de los cuatro sectores. Arranca Wokwi y comprueba Enlace ESP32.');
    }
  }

  function canCapture(data) {
    return live() && !waitingForEsp(data) && data.sectors.every((sector) => sector.valid);
  }

  function captureExperiment() {
    if (!canCapture(current)) return;
    const packet = current.measured ? current.transport.packet : null;
    experimentInput = {
      source: packet ? 'Wokwi' : 'Simulador interno',
      captured: new Date().toISOString(), seq: packet?.seq,
      soil: current.sectors.map((sector) => sector.moisture), ...current.supply
    };
    results = RiegoGuard.experiment(experimentInput);
    const { source, soil, flow, pressure } = experimentInput;
    const values = soil.map((value, index) => 'S' + (index + 1) + ' ' + format(value, 2) + ' %').join(' · ');
    set('e4-input', source + (packet ? ' #' + packet.seq : '') + ' · ' + values + ' · '
      + format(flow, 2) + ' L/min · ' + format(pressure, 2) + ' bar · ' + new Date(experimentInput.captured).toLocaleString('es-PE'));
    find('download').disabled = false;
    find('e4-daily').hidden = false;
    renderExperiment();
  }

  function renderExperiment() {
    find('summary').innerHTML = results.map((result) => `
      <article class="card score ${result.mode}">
        <h2>${result.label}</h2>
        <div class="score-metrics">
          <div><span>Consumo promedio</span><strong>${format(result.intensity, 2)}</strong> <small>L/m²/día</small></div>
          <div><span>Tiempo en banda</span><strong>${format(result.band, 1)} %</strong></div>
        </div>
        <div class="score-meter" aria-hidden="true"><span style="width:${result.band}%"></span></div>
        <p>${format(result.liters, 1)} L proyectados en siete días</p>
      </article>`).join('');
    const [auto, fixed] = results;
    find('daily-results').innerHTML = auto.daily.map((day, index) => `
      <tr><th scope="row">Día ${day.day}</th><td>${format(day.intensity, 2)}</td><td>${format(day.band, 1)} %</td>
        <td>${format(fixed.daily[index].intensity, 2)}</td><td>${format(fixed.daily[index].band, 1)} %</td></tr>`).join('');
  }

  registerControls();
  render(RiegoGuard.snapshot(state));
  const requestedView = new URL(location.href).searchParams.get('view');
  if (viewIds.includes(requestedView)) showView(requestedView);
  if (serverMode) {
    find('native-link').hidden = false;
    const base = new URL(document.baseURI);
    const port = base.port || (base.protocol === 'https:' ? '443' : '80');
    set('esp-endpoint', 'POST http://host.wokwi.internal:' + port + '/riegoguard/esp32');
    refresh();
    setInterval(refresh, 500);
  } else {
    setInterval(() => send('tick'), 1000);
  }
})();
</script>
</body>
</html>
